'''Lou''' is a [[Southeast Admiralty Islands languages|Southeast Admiralty Islands language]] spoken on [[Lou Island]] of [[Manus Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]] by 1,000 people.<ref name=e18/>

==Dialects==
There are three dialects. The main dialect is Rei.

==Grammar==
Lou has thirteen consonants and seven vowels. It is a [[nominative–accusative language]] and has [[subject–verb–object]] (SVO) word order.<ref>{{Cite thesis |last=Stutzman |first=Verna |title=A Study of the Lou Verb Phrase |date=1997 |degree=MA |publisher=University of Manitoba  |language=en |hdl=1993/1324 |hdl-access=free}}</ref>
